notes.subject: i
notes.rationale: taɛbranit ur tesɛi ara awal-agi n tuqqna; yettwarna i lmend n tseddut n teqbaylit

notes.subject: nnefs
notes.rationale: נפש d aneggez n udem, n tmeddurt — qrib ɣer 'nnefs' deg teqbaylit, mačči d 'iḥric n tmeddurt'

notes.subject: אחרית
notes.rationale: KJV 'reward' (tidri) ɣef YLT 'posterity' (ittiden); taɛbranit tenna-d 'taggara/timesriṛ' kan

notes.subject: arraǧ
notes.rationale: תקוה s unamek-is alit d 'azrir' (ccḍel); tettwaḥrez s unamek n rray: arraǧ

notes.subject: i mmi-s
notes.rationale: talɣa n talut (כן... דעה) d aneḍru ɣer mmi-s, amzun d ayen i d-yellan deg 24:13

translation: Akka, ssen ⟨i⟩ nnefs-ik tiṭ n tneḥlit: ma tufiḍ-tt, yella taggara, d arraǧ-ik ur yettwaɣzem.
